text: I ratify the WAIT camp's h1_close_above:bar_high on H1: D 9>21 but 3.16% under the 20-day high, W 6.13% under, H1 below EMA9: not at its high, so the new high must print first (C5). reclaim:ma_20 buys the pullback; I do not. The Creek pull-in step I do not need; seow's trade_above:bar_high on D is the same new-high idea and I could act on it. Wrong if a one-day fall of 1x atr_14d from the day's high, or a close under bar_low-1atr (C7, my translation).
